params.name: b
params.description: Right-hand side matrix/vector of shape [m, n].

returns.description: Solution matrix X of shape [m, n].

NDWasmBlas.matVecMul.description: Matrix-Vector Multiplication: y = A * x.Complexity: O(m * n)

NDWasmBlas.ger.description: Vector Outer Product (Rank-1 Update): A = x * y^T.Complexity: O(m * n)

NDWasmDecomp.description: NDWasmDecomp: Decompositions & SolversHandles O(n^3) matrix factorizations and linear system solutions.

NDWasmDecomp.solve.description: Solves a system of linear equations: Ax = B for x.Complexity: O(n^3)

params.name: a
params.description: Square coefficient matrix of shape [n, n].

params.name: b
params.description: Right-hand side matrix or vector of shape [n, k].

returns.description: Solution matrix x of shape [n, k].

NDWasmDecomp.inv.description: Computes the multiplicative inverse of a square matrix.Complexity: O(n^3)

params.name: a
params.description: Square matrix to invert of shape [n, n].

returns.description: The inverted matrix of shape [n, n].

NDWasmDecomp.svd.description: Computes the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD): A = U * S * V^T.Complexity: O(m * n * min(m, n))

NDWasmDecomp.qr.description: Computes the QR decomposition: A = Q * R.Complexity: O(n^3)

NDWasmDecomp.cholesky.description: Computes the Cholesky decomposition of a symmetric, positive-definite matrix: A = L * L^T.Complexity: O(n^3)

params.name: a
params.description: Symmetric positive-definite matrix of shape [n, n].

returns.description: Lower triangular matrix L of shape [n, n].

NDWasmDecomp.lu.description: Computes the LU decomposition of a matrix: A = P * L * U.The result is stored in-place in the output matrix.

NDWasmDecomp.pinv.description: Computes the Moore-Penrose pseudo-inverse of a matrix using SVD.Complexity: O(n^3)

NDWasmDecomp.det.description: Computes the determinant of a square matrix.Complexity: O(n^3)

NDWasmDecomp.logDet.description: Computes the log-determinant for improved numerical stability.Complexity: O(n^3)

NDWasmDecomp.eigen.description: Computes the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a general square matrix.Eigenvalues and eigenvectors can be complex numbers.The results are returned in an interleaved format where each complex number (a + bi)is represented by two consecutive float64 values (a, b).

params.name: a
params.description: Input square matrix of shape `[n, n]`. Must be float64.

returns.description: An object containing:  - `values`: Complex eigenvalues as an NDArray of shape `[n, 2]`, where `[i, 0]` is real and `[i, 1]` is imaginary.  - `vectors`: Complex right eigenvectors as an NDArray of shape `[n, n, 2]`, where `[i, j, 0]` is real and `[i, j, 1]` is imaginary.             (Note: these are column vectors, such that `A * v = lambda * v`).

NDWasmImage.description:
Provides WebAssembly-powered functions for image processing.
This module allows for efficient conversion between image binary data and NDArrays.

NDWasmImage.decode.description:
Decodes a binary image into an NDArray.
Supports common formats like PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP.
The resulting NDArray will have a shape of [height, width, 4] and a 'uint8c' dtype,
representing RGBA channels. This provides a consistent starting point for image manipulation.

params.name: imageBytes
params.description: The raw binary data of the image file.

returns.description: A 3D NDArray representing the image, or null if decoding fails.

NDWasmImage.encode.description: Encodes an NDArray into a binary image format (PNG or JPEG).

params.name: ndarray
params.description:
The input array.
  Supported dtypes: 'uint8', 'uint8c', 'float32', 'float64'. Float values should be in the range [0, 1].
  Supported shapes: [h, w] (grayscale), [h, w, 1] (grayscale), [h, w, 3] (RGB), or [h, w, 4] (RGBA).

params.name: options.format
params.description: The target format: 'png' or 'jpeg'. It is recommended to use the `encodePng` or `encodeJpeg` helpers instead.

params.name: options.quality
params.description: The quality for JPEG encoding (1-100). Ignored for PNG.

returns.description: A Uint8Array containing the binary data of the encoded image, or null on failure.

NDWasmImage.encodePng.description:
Encodes an NDArray into a PNG image.
This is a helper function that calls `encode` with `format: 'png'`.

params.name: ndarray
params.description: The input array. See `encode` for supported shapes and dtypes.

returns.description: A Uint8Array containing the binary data of the PNG image.

examples:
const grayArr = ndarray.zeros([16, 16]);
const pngBytes = NDWasmImage.encodePng(grayArr);

NDWasmImage.encodeJpeg.description:
Encodes an NDArray into a JPEG image.
This is a helper function that calls `encode` with `format: 'jpeg'`.

params.name: ndarray
params.description: The input array. See `encode` for supported shapes and dtypes.

returns.description: A Uint8Array containing the binary data of the JPEG image.

examples:
const floatArr = NDArray.random([20, 20, 3]);
const jpegBytes = NDWasmImage.encodeJpeg(floatArr, { quality: 85 });

NDWasmImage.convertUint8ArrrayToDataurl.description:
Converts a Uint8Array of binary data into a Base64 Data URL.
This is a utility function that runs purely in JavaScript.

params.name: mimeType
params.description: The MIME type for the Data URL (e.g., 'image/jpeg').

OPTIMIZE_STATUS_MAP.description: Maps status codes from gonum/optimize to human-readable messages.

NDWasmOptimize.description: Namespace for Optimization functions using Go WASM.

NDWasmOptimize.linprog.description:
Provides Optimization capabilities by wrapping Go WASM functions.
minimize cᵀ * x
s.t      G * x <= h
	        A * x = b
         lower <= x <= upper

params.name: c
params.description: Coefficient vector for the objective function (1D NDArray of float64).

params.name: G
params.description: Coefficient matrix for inequality constraints (2D NDArray of float64).

params.name: h
params.description: Right-hand side vector for inequality constraints (1D NDArray of float64).

params.name: A
params.description: Coefficient matrix for equality constraints (2D NDArray of float64).

params.name: b
params.description: Right-hand side vector for equality constraints (1D NDArray of float64).

params.name: bounds
params.description: Optional variable bounds as an array of [lower, upper] pairs. Use null for unbounded. [0, null] for all for default.

NDWasmOptimize.linearRegression.description: Fits a simple linear regression model: Y = alpha + beta*X.

params.name: x
params.description: The independent variable (1D NDArray of float64).

params.name: y
params.description: The dependent variable (1D NDArray of float64).

returns.description: - An object containing the intercept (alpha) and slope (beta) of the fitted line.

NDWasmOptimize.minimize.description: Finds the minimum of a scalar function of one or more variables using an L-BFGS optimizer.

params.name: func
params.description: The objective function to be minimized. It must take a 1D `Float64Array` `x` (current point) and return a single number (the function value at `x`).

params.name: x0
params.description: The initial guess for the optimization (1D NDArray of float64).

params.name: options.grad
params.description: The gradient of the objective function. Must take `x` (a 1D `Float64Array`) and write the result into the second argument `grad_out` (a 1D `Float64Array`). This function should *not* return a value.

NDWasmSignal.description: NDWasmSignal: Signal Processing & TransformationsHandles O(n log n) frequency domain transforms and O(n^2 * k^2) spatial filters.

NDWasmSignal.fft.description: 1D Complex-to-Complex Fast Fourier Transform.The input array must have its last dimension of size 2 (real and imaginary parts).The transform is performed in-place.Complexity: O(n log n)

returns.description: - Complex result, with the same shape as input.

NDWasmSignal.ifft.description: 1D Inverse Complex-to-Complex Fast Fourier Transform.The input array must have its last dimension of size 2 (real and imaginary parts).The transform is performed in-place.Complexity: O(n log n)

returns.description: - Complex time-domain result, with the same shape as input.

NDWasmSignal.rfft.description: 1D Real-to-Complex Fast Fourier Transform (Optimized for real input).The output is a complex array with shape [n/2 + 1, 2].Complexity: O(n log n)

NDWasmSignal.rifft.description: 1D Complex-to-Real Inverse Fast Fourier Transform.The input must be a complex array of shape [k, 2], where k is n/2 + 1.

params.name: n
params.description: Length of the original real signal.

NDWasmSignal.fft2.description: 2D Complex-to-Complex Fast Fourier Transform.The input array must be 3D with shape [rows, cols, 2].The transform is performed in-place.Complexity: O(rows * cols * log(rows * cols))

params.name: a
params.description: 2D Complex input signal, with shape [rows, cols, 2].

returns.description: - 2D Complex result, with the same shape as input.

NDWasmSignal.ifft2.description: 2D Inverse Complex-to-Complex Fast Fourier Transform.The input array must be 3D with shape [rows, cols, 2].The transform is performed in-place.

params.name: a
params.description: 2D Complex frequency-domain signal, with shape [rows, cols, 2].

returns.description: - 2D Complex time-domain result, with the same shape as input.

NDWasmSignal.dct.description: 1D Discrete Cosine Transform (Type II).Complexity: O(n log n)

NDWasmSignal.conv2d.description: 2D Spatial Convolution.Complexity: O(img_h * img_w * kernel_h * kernel_w)

NDWasmSignal.correlate2d.description: 2D Spatial Cross-Correlation.Similar to convolution but without flipping the kernel.Complexity: O(img_h * img_w * kernel_h * kernel_w)
